summary: This document describes a way for DNS operators to update DNSSEC delegation trust information using the DNS itself as the communication channel. It targets cases where moving key information from a child zone to its parent is currently hard, such as when rolling Key Signing Keys.

eli5.summary: When a child gets a new house key, the parent needs a copy. This RFC lets the child leave a note in the DNS so the parent can find the new key without lots of paperwork.

questions: how to roll dnssec ksk with parent
